descriptionMarkdown:
English version of https://factorioprints.com/view/-OqLYvVcrQdLV5k4TtTr by k3rNex

All element sizes are multiples of the chunk size. A book with 4 variations of modular city blocks: 1 - Initial stage (only rails and traffic lights); 2 - Stage with drones; 3 - Energy stage (consisting of solar panels and batteries); 4 - Defense version based on version 3 (defense in the form of laser turrets). Each variation contains:

There are 3 types of intersections: 1 – Through intersection; 2 – Intersection with a U-turn inside; 3 – T-shaped intersection.
Road sections (TURNS): 1 — Straight section; 2 — Section with a turn; 3 — Loop turn; 4 — Economical turn to the spot (requires changes to other elements) — NOT RECOMMENDED FOR USE.
Stations (used on "straight sections"): 1 - Station for 3 cars; 2 - Station for 3 cars with reverse direction (used within the "straight section").
title: City Blocks (English)
